name: WealthView
description: Stellar treasury aggregation and intelligence API for agents and developer tools, with optional user-provided SEP-41 / Soroban contract token support and snapshot-based history.
primary_use_case: Aggregate multiple Stellar wallets into a unified treasury view and generate treasury intelligence including health score, idle capital, alerts, benchmarks, change detection, and executive briefs.
example_tasks: Analyze optional SEP-41 contract token exposure
Compare saved treasury snapshots over time
